# gitea_repository_files (Data Source)

Fetches multiple repository files in a single request.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repository_files" "example" {
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
  paths            = ["README.md", "VERSION"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `paths` (List of String) The repository paths to fetch.
- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner.

### Optional

- `branch` (String) The branch or ref to read from.

### Read-Only

- `files` (List of Object) The fetched file metadata and contents. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
